## Owner #381-B3 integration blueprint — docs only; product implementation still NO-GO

**Current stage:** ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT, not release preparation. The product has never been publicly released. This PR is a source-grounded, bounded design decision after [#394 B1](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/394) and [#395 B2](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/395), **NOT** a production code or migration authorization.

**Exact identity:** base master `3275ac7c72df8ae4139a30f16c7f649971324e97`, tree `009576241cd4e8e2ba12cc644a368314f599faa6`; candidate HEAD `ba3985d93a0c0627720d478988d25a704e8b5757`, tree `e3b9f6e0384090473cb2c07de9fbbf27c28c5d67`. One commit, only 2 new research Markdown/CSV files (+104/-0):
- `docs/project/research/issue-381-b3/OWNER-INTEGRATION-BLUEPRINT.md`: eight architecture decisions, verified source owners, FTS option comparison, provisional root/epoch/source model, ten downstream contract gates and immediate dependency-bound next stage.
- `docs/project/research/issue-381-b3/PRODUCTION-SOURCE-GATES.csv`: 16 precise callsite/authority rows to drive **targeted** production mapping without mislabeling test-only code or claiming all 169 untraced registrations are implementation targets.

### Key source findings (master, not speculation)
1. `db/queries/mod.rs:79-103`, `db/queries/library/mod.rs:727-849,1406-1455`, `db/queries/files.rs:27-65`: current Managed source reads use a global `files.is_stale=0` guard; root scope is derived from enabled/healthy paths, not durable per-root E0/E1 claims.
2. `db/schema.rs:2763-2818`: `files_fts` is external-content trigram on the physical `files` table; its `files_au` trigger fires on **any UPDATE**, including `is_stale` edits. `library/mod.rs:1424,1434` computes `bm25(files_fts,6,1.5)` using the physical retained corpus, not B2's globally effective-visible corpus. Rowid membership filtering **after BM25** cannot prove strict rank parity.
3. `scan.rs` currently upserts the mutable `files` row **before** reconciliation; a member-only epoch pointer does not freeze E0 attributes/FTS/triggers. Production candidate [#383](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/383) still holds a 100k update/invalidation transaction (~5284ms in Hosted Windows) versus unchanged 5000ms metadata writer budget.
4. `file_user_tags` has ON DELETE CASCADE to `files`; old user annotations and independently committed file/action data cannot be garbage-collected via row deletion. Library already has `library_query_state` cursor/count revision and tags CAS; preserve/reuse them with correct new visibility/rank fences.

### Owner research disposition
- B2 semantic model [#395](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/pull/395) is accepted as **isolated test-only evidence** (16/16, 6/6, [final CI 38376866627 SUCCESS](https://github.com/ArdenZC/Zen-Canvas/actions/runs/38376866627)), **NOT** product Schema37, FTS external-content/trigram, native Windows 100k or production implementation evidence.
- **B3 blocking questions:** versioning old E0 metadata, per-root identity/overlap, exact effective BM25 corpus without per-request FTS rebuild, every real mass-stale/upsert owner, linked cursor/derived/action fences, real Hosted Windows writer liveness.
- Propose a **single bounded, test-only B3-F product-linked FTS feasibility comparison** of prebuilt effective index vs indexed effective statistics, using actual bundled SQLite/trigram; no production code/DDL and no unconditional new IPC/Schema. After that, choose minimum production implementation slices instead of a new omnibus research program.
- Frozen S8/S8R remain unchanged; B1 16 known test-only mislabels still excluded. #383 remains OPEN/Draft/DESIGN BLOCKED, Schema v38 unallocated. #380 Windows Service admission is separate.
- Ordinary automatic docs CI may run. **Do not run manual Full Validation, Codex Review, merge, close Issues, modify master or release.**
title: docs(research): #381-B3 effective visibility production integration blueprint
